digest.component_or_area: Gerrit CI / review scanner advisory workflow
propositions: The review scanner integration must be re-landed as a separate non-voting advisory workflow outside the required Gerrit Verified aggregate to prevent a required CI job failure from blocking all merges.

The scanner integration workflow must live in a separate .github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml file and must not appear in gerrit-verify.yaml, vote.needs, or vote normalization to satisfy ADR 0114 advisory requirements.
The scanner installer must support relative .tools/review-scanners prefix from another working directory with semgrep bin symlink resolving to an executable target.

The scanner manifest must declare independent linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 platform entries with exact Gitleaks URLs and SHA-256 checksums, with corresponding Semgrep requirements locks and pip install --require-hashes validation.

Static tests must prove scanner-integration is non-voting/non-blocking, outside Verified workflow-conclusion aggregation, and that mechanism-delta allows the advisory CI gates as explicitly justified exceptions.

Generated docs/security.md must document the scanner-lock manifest as update authority, include checksum provenance, per-platform bump examples, and withdrawn-asset recovery procedures via the curated narrative in gen_config_reference.py.
